content.rendered:
UPDATE: The issue has now been fixed. If you still experience any problems, please let us know by contacting us at (503)-925-8007.

=======================================

We are currently experiencing technical issues with our email. We will not receive emails sent to any @sherwoodcharterschool.org address. We are working to fix the issue and will post an update once things are back up and running.

If you have sent us an email in the the last 24 hours, it is likely that we did not receive it. Please contact us again once it has been announced that the problem is fixed. You can also leave us a voicemail message at (503)-925-8007 and we will return your call next week.

Thank you for your patience!
